summary.en: English sky, French ciel and Chinese 天/盖 each have independently documented histories; none establishes an English–Chinese cognate relation.

claim.en: Middle English sky continues Old Norse ský ‘cloud’; the English sense expanded to the visible upper region.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 sky 承自古诺尔斯语 ský“云”，英语词义后来扩展至可见的上方空间。

claim.en: French ciel continues Latin caelum, ‘celestial vault / heaven.’
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 ciel 承自拉丁语 caelum“天穹／天界”。

claim.en: Early forms of 天 emphasize a person's head or highest point; the graph subsequently denotes the sky.
claim.zh-Hans: “天”的早期字形突出人首或最高处，后来用于表示天空。

proposition.en: The blue sky is the cover above us, changing through day and night, sun and moon, and the turning seasons.
proposition.zh-Hans: 蓝天是覆盖我们的被盖，昼日夜月，四季变换。

text.en: Standing on a mountain and looking up at the sky, I watch the white clouds wandering overhead. At moments the earth itself seems to move, while the houses rise and fall like sampans and ocean liners. Across oceans and great rivers, wherever we are able to sail, we may never travel over every part of Mother Earth. Even in passing, however, we may glimpse her skin and the places where her bones lie exposed—the mountains, ridges and valleys. The blue sky is the cover above us, changing through day and night, sun and moon, and the turning seasons.
text.zh-Hans: 站在山上向天空仰望，覺得天上的白雲在遊走，偶爾也會覺得地在走，房屋似此起彼伏的舢板與郵輪。在海洋、大河，在我們能夠航行的地方，我們雖未遊走在這大地母親的每一處，哪怕只是走馬觀花，也可以看看地母的每處肌膚、每處骨骼外露之處——那是山脈與丘壑。那藍天是我們的被蓋，晝日夜月，四季變換。

evidence_boundary.en: Literature may explore freely, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文学可以自由展开，但不属于历史证据。

source.raw_note: 英语：sky n. 天；汉语：盖【gai】n.。六十四卦图是我们的另一种文字。所有卦象都是从乾卦而来。附乾卦原文、坤卦标题、天字字源说明、盖天说、《敕勒歌》，以及站在山上仰望白云、房屋如舢板与邮轮、大地母亲的肌肤与骨骼、蓝天是被盖的文学段落。原稿另将卫星、电离层和平流层并置为所仰望的盖天结构；编辑版将古代模型、现代大气层与地球外部空间分开说明。

limitations.en: Modern-form resemblance is not a regular sound correspondence or proof of cognacy.

claim.en: The sixty-four hexagrams may be studied as another kind of writing; the author proposes Qian as their originating structure.
claim.zh-Hans: 六十四卦图可以作为我们的另一种文字来研究；作者提出“所有卦象都是从乾卦而来”。

counterexamples: This is not presented as a settled historical or Yijing conclusion
The combinatorial system also requires yin lines and includes Kun ☷ as a basic contrast

testability.en: Define ‘originating structure’ and compare it with received-text, excavated-text and combinatorial accounts of the hexagram system.
